segments.text: Good morning, and welcome back to Equi-Tix.
segments.zh: 早上好，欢迎回到 EquiTips。

segments.text: Today we have a special guest with us, Andy Galuli.
segments.zh: 今天我们请来了一位特别嘉宾，Andy Galuli。

segments.text: Andy is the Vice President of Sales of DK-Lok,
segments.zh: Andy 是 DK-Lok 的销售副总裁，

segments.text: one of our trusted brands and strong partners.
segments.zh: DK-Lok 是我们信赖的品牌之一，也是我们的重要合作伙伴。

segments.text: Andy, can you tell me a little bit about DK-Lok?
segments.zh: Andy，能给我们介绍一下 DK-Lok 吗？

segments.text: Well, first off, thank you for having me.
segments.zh: 好的，首先，感谢你们邀请我。

segments.text: And DK-Lok is an emerging and has been for 25 years
segments.zh: DK-Lok 是一家新兴的、而且 25 年来一直如此的

segments.text: a global manufacturer of instrumentation,
segments.zh: 全球性制造商，生产仪表类、

segments.text: high precision products and solutions
segments.zh: 高精度的产品和解决方案，

segments.text: both in the fluid conveyance and testing
segments.zh: 涵盖流体输送以及测试

segments.text: and measurement area.
segments.zh: 和测量领域。

segments.text: That sounds pretty cool, Andy.
segments.zh: 听起来很不错，Andy。

segments.text: So, Tom here, what are the different applications
segments.zh: 那么 Tom，DK-Lok 有哪些不同的

segments.text: that DK-Lok is used for?
segments.zh: 应用领域呢？

segments.text: Where can I find DK-Lok products?
segments.zh: 在哪里能找到 DK-Lok 的产品？

segments.text: DK is found in virtual, every industry.
segments.zh: 几乎每个行业都能找到 DK。

segments.text: We've seen both major and sub-emerging industries,
segments.zh: 无论是主要行业还是新兴的细分行业，我们都有涉足，

segments.text: find it in oil and gas, find chemical pulp and paper,
segments.zh: 在石油和天然气、化工、制浆造纸行业都能找到它，

segments.text: also semiconductor and even aerospace.
segments.zh: 还有半导体，甚至航空航天。

segments.text: Can you tell me DK-Lok has been to Mars?
segments.zh: 能告诉我 DK-Lok 去过火星吗？

segments.text: Not quite, but there are discussions
segments.zh: 还没有，不过正在讨论中，

segments.text: and that discussion hinges on our AS9100 approval
segments.zh: 而这个讨论取决于我们的 AS9100 认可

segments.text: and NADCAP certification.
segments.zh: 和 NADCAP 认证。

segments.text: And so, more to come.
segments.zh: 所以，敬请期待。

segments.text: That sounds pretty cool.
segments.zh: 听起来很不错。

segments.text: So, Tom, obviously DK-Lok is one of the leading brands
segments.zh: 那么 Tom，显然 DK-Lok 是其行业中

segments.text: in its industry.
segments.zh: 领先的品牌之一。

segments.text: Why should people go to DK-Lok
segments.zh: 为什么人们应该选择 DK-Lok，

segments.text: rather than its competitors?
segments.zh: 而不是它的竞争对手呢？

segments.text: Well, it starts with the piece of mind.
segments.zh: 首先是让人安心。

segments.text: Based on our interchangeability and our warranty
segments.zh: 基于我们与市场领导者产品的互换性，

segments.text: that comes with that with the market leader,
segments.zh: 以及随之附带的质保，

segments.text: it gives that customer and the market
segments.zh: 它给客户和市场带来了

segments.text: something that we haven't had
segments.zh: 我们以前没有的，

segments.text: or it hasn't had up until this point.
segments.zh: 或者说市场到目前为止还没有的东西。

segments.text: And that is we will warrant our product
segments.zh: 那就是，我们的产品在与市场领导者产品互换使用时，

segments.text: as it's interchanged with that market leader
segments.zh: 我们会为其提供质保，

segments.text: based on extensive third-party testing.
segments.zh: 这是基于大量的第三方测试。

segments.text: Also, our certifications.
segments.zh: 还有我们的认证。

segments.text: We've been doing certifications third-party
segments.zh: 我们从公司创立起

segments.text: since inception and those certifications include,
segments.zh: 就一直在做第三方认证，这些认证包括

segments.text: but not limited to ASME, ISO,
segments.zh: 但不限于 ASME、ISO、

segments.text: NADCAP, AS9100 and the like.
segments.zh: NADCAP、AS9100 等等。

segments.text: And so, in addition to that,
segments.zh: 除此之外，

segments.text: it's our constant quality measures
segments.zh: 还有我们持续不断的质量措施，

segments.text: through SBC quality management,
segments.zh: 通过 SPC 质量管理来实现，

segments.text: which is in real time
segments.zh: 它在我们各个生产工厂

segments.text: at our individual manufacturing facilities.
segments.zh: 实时进行。

segments.text: And we strive to make the best quality product
segments.zh: 我们力求以最高的效率

segments.text: at the most efficient rate.
segments.zh: 生产出质量最好的产品。

segments.text: So it sounds like it's a no-brainer.
segments.zh: 听起来这根本不用犹豫。

segments.text: People should go with DK-Lok.
segments.zh: 大家就应该选择 DK-Lok。

segments.text: Where can they find DK-Lok?
segments.zh: 在哪里能买到 DK-Lok？

segments.text: I don't know of a better place than Equigas.
segments.zh: 我想不出比 EquiGas 更好的地方了。
